source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official latest-release discovery and DuckDB query entrypoint.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Overture publishes a STAC catalog whose latest field points to the current release. The official quickstart shows DuckDB loading httpfs, setting s3_region=us-west-2, and querying cloud GeoParquet with bbox predicates.

The DuckDB guide requires DuckDB 1.1.0 or newer, installs/loads httpfs for Amazon S3, and states that queries download only requested attributes. Its regional extract example reads the buildings/building GeoParquet path and filters bbox fields.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Official S3 catalog path and partition contract.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: Official Overture core data is hosted at s3://overturemaps-us-west-2/release/<RELEASE>, partitioned by theme and type. Buildings includes feature types building and building_part, stored as GeoParquet.

source_evidence_manifest.record_scope: Building feature semantics and free availability.
source_evidence_manifest.relevant_record_ids_or_excerpt: The buildings theme is freely available. A building feature represents the outer footprint of a human-made structure and carries a stable Overture id plus bbox and building attributes; building_part is separate and linked by building_id.

DuckDB httpfs provides S3 access for remote Parquet scans. Remote Parquet queries can use projection and filter pushdown so only required column chunks and row groups are fetched rather than downloading the complete dataset.
